notes.zh-CN: 会话与消息改为 SQLite 存储。升级后首次启动会把原 state.json 一次性迁移，并保留为 state.json.pre-sqlite-<时间戳> 备份；此后流式回复只写变更行，不再整份重写数百 MB 的状态文件。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Sessions and messages now live in SQLite. The first launch after upgrading imports the existing state.json once and keeps it as a state.json.pre-sqlite-<timestamp> backup; streaming turns then update only changed rows instead of rewriting a multi-hundred-MB file. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
